productionBoundaryAssessment.desktopLiveState: Consecutive desktop Advance calls deserialize currentGameStateJson populated with serializeRuntimeState, while canonical serializeState is maintained separately for disk autosave. The actual turns 14..19 are direct advances; Save/Load occurs only after turn 39.
productionBoundaryAssessment.conclusion: Canonical transient stripping is not the live boundary in this uninterrupted native execution. The proven production branch is commander operation construction on turn 17. A native-only IPC/canonicalization defect is rejected by the call chain.
productionBoundaryAssessment.headlessComparisonLimit: The accepted headless run and actual native run do not have identical player inputs or identical turn-16 military operands. N98 used the bot default civic choice and deny response while native selected civic and always_allow at turn 0. The policy field alone is not causal: by turn 16 both states contain exactly 4 RBiH and 28 RS deployed paramilitary formations, and the turn-15 Black Swans reserve request has the same accepted outcome and brigade/corps assignment (only decided_by differs). Concrete military differences remain: native Foča is 760 personnel/morale 64 versus n98 751/62, native Ajnie is 489/55 versus 480/53, and native 109th is 682 versus 685. Circle itself differs only 4310 versus 4313 initial strength while retaining the same roster and axes. The retained evidence therefore cannot classify the missing enemy probe as a missing native capability rather than a legitimate response to accumulated state differences.

ordinaryPlayerActionAvailability.finding: No retained ordinary player action was available before the critical turn-18 resolution that is shown to strengthen or retry this already-authorized historical Circle operation.
details: At turn 16 ARBiH 1st Corps has both operation slots occupied: the recovering turn-12 probe and planning Operation Circle; there is no pending operation directive or halt.

The operation-decision IPC supports launch, postpone, abort, and probe. It does not add a participant, replace an axis brigade, or retry a failed objective, and the actual transcript does not show a Circle operation-decision surface before turn-18 combat.

The player can approve an Army Reserve request only when one exists. The accepted turn-15 request sends Black Swans to 2nd Corps, not Circle. The later 1st Corps request names a Sarajevo OG recipient and appears after Circle's first failed attacks; it is not retained as a Circle participant or reinforcement.
Author/request-operation levers exist, but a turn-16 request to 1st Corps would meet a full two-slot state and is not evidence of strengthening Circle.
ordinaryPlayerActionAvailability.qualification: Mechanism existence does not satisfy the 707/no-loss acceptance criterion. Any claimed player-action route still needs a visible production command before the critical resolution, persistence through Save/Load, and an actual 707/no-loss result.

nextCheapestProductionCheck.stoppingRule: One four-advance attempt with a 30-second hard cap. If either repeated pair is non-self-reproducible or either branch fails its retained operation-envelope fidelity, stop without interpreting the predicate or retrying. Canonical archives omit runtime transients, so success identifies the persistent-state branch; failure means an exact uninterrupted-runtime receipt requires a future native capture and is outside this check.
